basic_info.description: Set on one of Duboce Triangle's most charming tree-lined blocks, 82 Henry is a stylishly remodeled top-floor condo designed for modern city living. With soaring beamed ceilings, seven skylights, and a smart, open layout, this two-bedroom, two-bath home delivers the perfect blend of design, comfort, and functionality ideal for entertaining, working from home, and unwinding in style. The sunken living room with a wood-burning fireplace and warm natural light flows effortlessly into the dining area and out to a private deck overlooking tranquil Henry Street, your new favorite spot for morning coffee or sunset wine. The chef's kitchen is a statement in itself, featuring quartz countertops, Heath Ceramics tile backsplash, custom cabinetry, and a premium Thermador appliance suite (gas range with hood, electric oven with rotisserie, microwave, dishwasher, and cabinet-front fridge).  Both bedrooms are en-suite and generously sized, offering flexible spaces for work-from-home setups, guests, or roommates. Thoughtfully renovated bathrooms include skylights, hex-tile floors, custom vanities, and electric Toto washlets. Access to a roof top deck with panoramic downtown and city views, in-unit washer/dryer, deeded parking with EV charger & tranquil shared rear garden complete the offering!
